New listing (posted August 28, 2026)

Hanno City is hosting a Mental Health Forum. The topic is "Practical psychological skills for everyday life: stress management and mental health in the workplace." Lecturer Kosuke Akiyama, a certified psychologist and clinical psychologist, will explain easy-to-understand approaches to managing stress effectively.

Date and time: October 1, 2026 (Thursday), 2:00 p.m.–4:00 p.m. (doors open 1:30 p.m.)
Venue: Hanno City Fujimi District Community Center Assembly Hall (16 Futayanagi, Hanno)
Capacity: 100 people (first come, first served)

Application period: September 1–25, 2026 (Tuesday 9:00 a.m. through Friday 4:30 p.m.)

How to apply:
• Online application
• Fax (042-974-6558): include your address, name, phonetic spelling of your name, and phone number
• Phone (042-974-3488)

If you need sign language interpretation, please request it by September 8, 2026. Parking is available at Hanno City Hall.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/14150.html
